description: Requirements for a Salesforce Enterprise Territory Management (ETM) territory design: alignment criteria, coverage model selection, assignment rule logic, hierarchy depth and breadth, and user-to-territory ratios. Trigger keywords: territory design, territory alignment, territory model requirements, sales coverage model, territory criteria, geographic territory, named account territory, overlay territory. NOT for ETM setup steps — use admin/enterprise-territory-management. NOT for loading territory assignment data — use data/territory-data-alignment. Trigger keywords: territory design questionnaire, territory requirements document, assignment rule matrix, territory type priority, realignment plan, territory access level decision, accountAccessLevel, opportunityAccessLevel, ObjectTerritory2Association, UserTerritory2Association, Planning state model, territory acceptance tests.
inputs: go-to-market motion (geographic, named account, industry overlay, or hybrid)
number of sales reps and managers requiring territory coverage
account segmentation criteria (geography, industry, revenue, employee count)
existing territory boundaries or coverage maps if redesigning
org edition (Enterprise, Performance, or Unlimited — affects territory limits)
current org-wide defaults for Account, Opportunity, Contact and Case
realignment cadence and the fiscal calendar it must land against
name: territory-design-requirements
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide (v66.0), `Territory2Rule` › Usage and `Territory2RuleItem` — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf (the 10-rule-item ceiling, the `operation` enum including `within` for DISTANCE criteria, positional rule-item order, `booleanFilter` numbering, `objectType` = Account, "Rules can't be run via Metadata API")
Metadata API Developer Guide, `Territory2Type` › `priority` — same PDF (highest integer wins opportunity territory assignment, priority must be unique per type, a same-type tie assigns no territory)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `Territory2` (fields, `parentTerritory`, `ruleAssociations`, `Territory2AccessLevel`) — same PDF (the `Read`/`Edit`/`All` and `None`/`Read`/`Edit` access enums, the OWD-dependent omission rules, developer-name parenting, the `inherited` flag on rule associations)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `Territory2Model` › Usage and `Territory2Settings` — same PDF (initial `Planning` state, deploy permitted only for `Planning`/`Active`, archived-name deploy block, cascade delete, `tm2BypassRealignAccInsert`, `supportedObjects` where "The only supported object type is `Lead`", Manage Territories required for `deploy()`)

Object Reference (v66.0), `Territory2Model` › `State`, `Territory2` › access-level picklists, `Territory2AlignmentLog`, `Territory2ObjectExclusion`, `TerritoryAdminAssignment` — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf (the nine model states, the SOQL access-level labels that differ from the Metadata API spellings, the rule-run log fields, the exclusion object, delegated territory administration)

Object Reference, `ObjectTerritory2Association`, `UserTerritory2Association`, `UserTerritory2AssocLog`, `AccountShare` › `RowCause` — same PDF (the `AssociationCause` values, `IsActive` and `RoleInTerritory2`, no `update()` on the membership object, the `Territory` and `Territory2AssociationManual` share reasons and the API 45.0 replacement of `TerritoryManual`)

Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf (checked and reported as a **negative**: a case-insensitive search for "territor" returns no lines, which is why every territory-count ceiling in this package is carried as an assumption rather than a limit)

`skills/admin/enterprise-territory-management/references/metadata-examples.md` and `references/gotchas.md` — the at-bar sibling this skill hands off to; the deployable `Territory2*` XML, the manifest, the deploy commands and the deeper deployment gotchas live there and are cross-referenced rather than duplicated

`standards/decision-trees/sharing-selection.md` — the ordered record-access layers that any "restrict reps to their own accounts" requirement must be routed through before it becomes a territory requirement
outputs: territory design requirements document capturing alignment criteria and hierarchy shape
recommended coverage model type (geographic, named account, overlay, or hybrid)
assignment rule criteria list with field-level specifications
checklist of requirements to hand off to the ETM configuration skill
machine-lintable territory-design YAML (territories, types, rules, access levels, realignment plan)
acceptance tests as SOQL over ObjectTerritory2Association and UserTerritory2Association
